body: The request slip lies on my desk, its stamped "REFUSED" a stark rebuke to my expectations. My eyes narrow, the heat of indignation seeping into my face. I ponder the circumstances, wondering if there was a miscommunication or misstep in my request. The thought sparks a question: what could have gone wrong?
